source.title: ReadWriteFile and WriteBinaryFile tests fail on macOS because the temp path contains a symlink

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

Two `n8n-nodes-base` tests fail on macOS with the default temp folder:

- `nodes/Files/ReadWriteFile/test/ReadWriteFile.test.ts`
- `nodes/WriteBinaryFile/test/WriteBinaryFile.test.ts`

The write node returns no output, so the assertion fails:

```
AssertionError: Equality failed for "nodes/WriteBinaryFile/test/WriteBinaryFile.workflow.json" at node "Write Binary File": expected [ null ] to deeply equal [ [ { …(2) } ] ]
```

The probable cause:

1. `NodeTestHarness.temporaryDir` creates its folder under `os.tmpdir()`. On macOS, this path starts with `/var/folders/...`, and `/var` is a symlink to `/private/var`.
2. Both tests mock `fsPromises.realpath` to return the path unchanged, so the symlink stays in the path.
3. On macOS, `openWithoutFollowingSymlinkedAncestors` calls `assertNoSymlinkInPath`, which should reject this path.

I did not capture the error from the node. The result below supports this cause: the tests pass when the temp path contains no symlink.

#39674 also lists these tests as failures on macOS, but I did not find an issue for them.

### To Reproduce

From `packages/nodes-base`, on macOS, with the default `TMPDIR`:

1. Run the tests. Both fail.

   ```bash
   pnpm test nodes/Files/ReadWriteFile/test/ReadWriteFile.test.ts nodes/WriteBinaryFile/test/WriteBinaryFile.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
   ```

2. Run the tests with the resolved temp path. Both pass.

   ```bash
   TMPDIR=$(python3 -c 'import os,tempfile;print(os.path.realpath(tempfile.gettempdir()))')/ pnpm test nodes/Files/ReadWriteFile/test/ReadWriteFile.test.ts nodes/WriteBinaryFile/test/WriteBinaryFile.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
   ```

### Expected behavior

Both tests pass on macOS with the default temp folder.

This change in `packages/core/nodes-testing/node-test-harness.ts` makes both tests pass on macOS:

const dir = mkdtempSync(path.join(realpathSync(tmpdir()), 'n8n-'));

Only these two test files use `temporaryDir`. I can open a PR for this change.

### Debug Info

Not applicable. This problem is in the test suite and does not need a running instance.

Tested on master at 18c045bfac.

### Operating System

macOS 26.6.2

### n8n Version

master (18c045bfac)

### Node.js Version

v24.9.0

### Database

SQLite (default)

### Execution mode

main (default)

### Hosting

self hosted

comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: The harness currently builds `temporaryDir` directly from `tmpdir()` (`packages/core/nodes-testing/node-test-harness.ts`), while both affected tests stub `fsPromises.realpath` to return its input. That leaves macOS’s `/var/...` alias in the path passed to the write node. Resolving the temp root before `mkdtempSync` in the harness (for example, `realpathSync(tmpdir())`) looks like a focused fix and keeps the change out of the individual tests. One thing to check in a PR is whether any other harness users rely on the exact temp-root behavior; the two affected tests’ async `realpath` stubs would not stub `realpathSync`.
